summary: Edible Garden AG Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose entry into a purchase agreement with Meijer Distribution, Inc. to supply Buyer-branded hydroponic, potted, and fresh cut herbs beginning January 2027 through December 2028. The agreement replaces prior agreements expiring December 31, 2026, with annual price renegotiation and tariff-related adjustment provisions. Termination rights include without cause on 60 days notice, for cause, and immediate termination for quality failures. This is a routine commercial supply contract, not a special situation, with no securities, M&A, or capital markets implications. The filing includes a press release and the agreement as exhibits. What to watch: future supply agreements or operational disclosures; no risk-arb angle applies.
